high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram story posted by the user "lindsaymariebrewer," as indicated by the username and verified badge at the top of the image. The post was made 12 hours prior to when the screenshot was taken, as shown by the timestamp "12h." The image captures a scenic coastal view with clear blue skies and lush greenery. In the foreground, there are tall palm trees and other tropical plants, including what looks like agave plants. A sandy beach is visible in the mid-ground, with gentle waves lapping against the shore. The ocean stretches out into the horizon
